title: Final: Play Bapu
concept: Now a real game, against me. I play like a strong club player, so don't worry about winning: play carefully, and run the checklist before every move.

glossary.definition: a move that throws away a big part of your position, usually by losing a piece or walking into mate.

summary: Games are lost by blunders, not won by brilliance. Run the checklist every move, and make your opponent find the good ideas.
